notes.subject: אשר לא יעדה
notes.rationale: Famously ambiguous: 'whom he has not designated (as wife)' — subject may be the master or the daughter; JPS takes master, others the daughter's refusal.

notes.subject: יעדה
notes.rationale: 'from יעד — to appoint/betroth: 'designated her (for himself)' vs 'betrothed her (to his son, v.9)'.

notes.subject: רעה בעיני
notes.rationale: 'bad in the eyes of' — literally displeasing; rendered 'e le mpe ka mahlong a'.

notes.subject: בבגדו בה
notes.rationale: Literally 'in his dealing treacherously with her' — verbal noun of בגד; rendered as causal clause 'ka gobane o ile a mo qhekella'.

translation: Ge e le mpe ka mahlong a morena wa yena, yeo a sa mo laelago, a mo lokollotše; go setšhaba sa sego sa gae ga a swanela go buša ka go mo rekhisa, ka gobane o ile a mo qhekella.

tokens.gloss: ka gobane o ile a mo qhekella
